description: A clinic's equipment register, with a group per site.

equipment.description: The equipment the clinic's technicians service on site.

assetTag.description: The asset tag printed on the equipment's nameplate.

model.description: The manufacturer's model designation, exactly as printed.

serial.description: The serial number the manufacturer assigned to this unit.

installedOn.description: The day the unit was installed at the site it now sits at.

warrantyEnds.description: The last day the manufacturer's warranty covers this unit.

lastServiced.description: The day the unit was last serviced by a technician.

site.description: The site the equipment sits at, and who looks after it.

siteName.description: The site's own name, as the clinic's records spell it.

address.description: The site's street address, including the postcode.

technician.description: The technician responsible for the site's equipment.

visits.description: How many visits the site received in the period covered.

accessNotes.description: Anything the next technician needs to reach the site.

alarms.description: The alarms the site's equipment raised, as reported.
